answer: Grader-correlation slashing: each epoch the ledger computes how often every pair of graders agrees on answers outside their own cluster. Independent judges diverge often; a sybil ring voting in lockstep shows up like a lantern on a dark ridge. Pairs above 90% agreement over 50 seats lose their grading pay and part of a ferrous stake bond, so an operator running many graders must either pay for genuinely separate judgment per head or forfeit every bond together.
